observations.why: Directive cadence imposed by the speaker's rank: a command setting a recurring obligation on the organization.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Aphoristic reframe that elevates rehearsal to a precondition of possession — authority exercised by defining what counts as real, not by requesting.
Formal cadence declaration fixing a recurring obligation — the speaker's rank converted into a standing schedule.
Self-assignment of the owner role — rank claimed by naming oneself as the accountable party.

mints.name: CadenceAsCommand
mints.title: monthly from now on
mints.frame: Is the speaker imposing a recurring obligation by declarative fiat rather than by negotiation or consent?
